notes.why_in_news: PM Modi offered continued support to Sri Lanka for cyclone relief, highlighting India's role in bilateral relations and disaster assistance.
notes.fact_box: PM Modi called Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake on December 1, 2025. India launched Operation Sagar Bandhu to provide relief and rescue assistance. So far, 53 tonnes of relief material have been handed over to Sri Lanka.
